svg.title: Accumulator charging – hysteresis
svg.text: 5 · Accumulator charging with hysteresis – pressure, unloading valve, machine demand
Network 9: load below 10.8 MPa, keep loading until 11.5 MPa; recharge after every movement (falling edge of CNC_MOVE). Band from guide 25 §14.5.
Hold: leakage 0.15 L/min (estimate) takes 0.15 L between 11.5 and 10.8 MPa (adiabatic n = 1.4) → ≈ 61 s; slow (isothermal) 0.20 L → 80 s (guide 25).
Charge: 0.15 L / (5.39 − 0.15) L/min ≈ 1.8 s per cycle → about 45 load cycles per hour; the motor keeps running (no motor starts).
Movement at 80 s (release + lift, 6 L/min for 1.6 s ≈ 0.16 L): pressure falls to ≈ 10.75 MPa; the falling edge of CNC_MOVE recharges at once.
Why 0.7 MPa hysteresis: with no band the valve would switch every scan (chatter). Rule: band ≥ 5 % of the pressure, and ≥ 2 × transmitter error
(0–16 MPa, 0.5 % FS = ± 0.08 MPa). The charge time-out (T_CHG 20 s) catches a worn pump, an open relief or a big leak.
Guide 37 · page 5 · EXAMPLE – check with your PLC configuration
